Name: Elite Platinum 5.5 Qt. Smart n' Healthy Multi-Cooker - Blue
Natural: Find Pressure Cookers at Target.com! The Smart n' Healthy Cooker uses innovative technology combining Sub-Boiling steam-based cooking with very exact temperatures to prepare delicious and nutritious meals. Using this advanced technology, food is cooked at just below its boiling point, never "Over-Boiling" which results in vegetables retaining their vibrant colors and structures compared to standard pressure cookers that can turn green vegetables into yellow mush. The Smart n' Healthy Cooker quietly monitors the water vapor, heat and condition of the Release Valve to effectively control the cooking atmosphere within the inner pot. In essence, sub-boiling technology gives you the same control that a master chef achieves when preparing foods at their ideal temperature so that your meals taste their absolute best. - 5.5-quart non-stick inner cooking pot capacity - 24-hour delay timer with memory function - Preprogrammed menu functions for Rice, Meat/Fish, Vegetables and Keep Warm. - Lid can be opened at Any time during the cooking process to add ingredients. - Set Custom Cook Time up to 4 hours. - Ability to cook rice like a standard rice cooker. - Touch-Screen control panel with Blue Led display. (No need to push or press down on button, panel responds to touch). - Cool-touch exterior with carrying handle - Transparent Tempered Glass viewing window constructed of aerospace glass that withstands pressure. - Due to it's unique pressure control with 8 protection devices, the lid can be opened at any time during cooking. - Save energy and cooking time up to 35 percent-60 percent less - 1000 Watts
